executableAssumptions.statement: These eight executable trusted-computing-base assumptions exactly record the Float refinement runtime contracts. They are not proof axioms and introduce no additional runtime contract.

assumptions.id: 83:Canonical re-encoding of Float.ofBits is JSNumber.sameValue to the source JSNumber.:77:Lean Float primitives are executable runtime bridges, not kernel definitions.
assumptions.statement: Canonical re-encoding of Float.ofBits is JSNumber.sameValue to the source JSNumber.

assumptions.id: 80:Canonical Float.add encoding is SameValue to JSNumber.add on canonical operands.:45:Float.add is an executable runtime primitive.
assumptions.statement: Canonical Float.add encoding is SameValue to JSNumber.add on canonical operands.
